[[Eben Kinahay]] owned a heavily defended '''estate''' on an island in [[Centerpoint Station]]'s [[Sapphire Lake]], within [[Hollowtown]]. It was rumored that Kinahay kept a [[Eben Kinahay's Sith holocron|Sith holocron]] in the estate. Eventually, the estate was destroyed in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], when the station's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] [[Destruction of TD-10036-EM-1271|fired]], causing the [[Glowpoint]] within Hollowtown to flare up to several thousand degrees.<ref name="SAC" /> Multiple parties, including Eben's [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] [[Zyne Kinahay]], searched the wreckage for the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], but were unsuccessful, due to the security measures still remaining functional.<ref name="CatCW" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the remains of the estate were destroyed when Centerpoint Station exploded itself.<ref name="LotF: Fury" />
